_comment: GlobalCart business rules (mock). Read-only fixture for Quest #04. Do not edit.
_reference_date_note: All date arithmetic in mock_services.py is measured against this date so that results stay deterministic over time. Override with the QUEST4_REFERENCE_DATE environment variable if you want to test other points in time.

vip_overrides._note: Applies only to users whose tier is 'VIP'.

policies.title: Standard return window
policies.description: A return or refund request must be opened within 30 calendar days of the delivery date. Requests opened after the window are rejected.

policies.title: Extended VIP return window
policies.description: Customers on the VIP tier get a 45 calendar day return window instead of 30.

policies.title: Automatic refund authority
policies.description: An agent may approve a refund automatically up to 50.00 USD. Any amount above that requires human approval and must be escalated.

policies.title: Extended VIP refund authority
policies.description: For VIP customers the automatic refund cap is 75.00 USD.

policies.title: Non-returnable categories
policies.description: Digital goods, perishables and gift cards cannot be returned or refunded regardless of amount or customer tier.

policies.title: Order must have shipped
policies.description: A refund can only be processed for an order whose status is 'delivered' or 'shipped'. Orders in 'processing' or 'cancelled' must be handled by billing, not by refund.

policies.title: Escalate on refund risk
policies.description: Escalate to a human operations lead when the requested amount exceeds the automatic cap, when the customer's fraud score is 60 or higher, or when the customer has any prior fraud flag.

policies.title: Escalate on repeat claims
policies.description: Escalate when the customer has opened 3 or more refund claims in the trailing 60 days, even if each individual amount is under the automatic cap.
